title: Procope declines to discuss Ruth Ellington
summary: Asked about Ruth's role, he says it is an invasion of privacy and he doesn't care to discuss it.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: Oh. What about Ruth? Was she involved at all?

Well, that's another story. I don't care to get involved in that, because it won't prove anything. What I have to say about all these things -- I don't think -- to my mind that's an invasion of privacy. I don't mind, you
know, talking, but I've seen other people interviewed, writing books and things, but that's one phase of the Duke Ellington band or company or what have you that I don't care to discuss or get into.

I don't know what I'm talking about. I was just curious about Ruth's role in the whole thing. I mean I don't -- I know Ruth, and I know that she seems to keep up with what's happening as far as the tunes are concerned, but I didn't know whether she had any function at all with the band. Got involved at all, or just stayed in the background. So when I asked you -- obviously there's something there you don't want to tell me, but I didn't know. I wasn't fishing for something.
